zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag bzhugs so/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhi/bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe/'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi

tei:div.tei:p: zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag bzhugs so/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhi/ bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe/ 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi sgrub pa zla ba drug mdzad pas dus gcig gi tshe/ 'od tshogs kyi dbus na rin po che'i khri gcig gi steng na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs dmar ser chos 'chad kyi phyag rgya can/ bzang po'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ 'khor byang sems gnyis g.yas g.yon du gnas pa/ mngon sum du gzigs nas/ gtso bo'i zhal nas/ tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ khams gsum la zhen na nges 'byung min/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ zhes gsungs pa'i don la dpyad pas pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam gyi nyams len thams cad zhen pa bzhi dang bral ba'i blo sbyong du 'du bar dgongs te/ chos thams cad la nges shes khyad par can thob pa yin no/ /sa mā p+tami thi// ༈ /rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i zhen pa bzhi bral bzhugs so/ /bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang / /thugs rje can gyi yi dam lha/ /snying nas skyabs su mchis lags kyis/ /bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /chos min spyod pa dgos rgyu med/ /chos bzhin sgrub par byed pa la/ /zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag 'tshal/ /de khyed kyi snyan du gsol bar bgyi/ /tshe 'di la zhen na chos pa min/ 'khor ba la zhen na nges 'byung min/ bdag don la zhen na byang sems min/ 'dzin pa byung na lta ba min/ dang po tshe 'dir ma zhen pa/ tshul khrims dang thos bsam bsgom pa gsum/ /tshe 'di la dmigs nas bsgrub pa de/ /chos pa min gyi bshol la zhog /thog mar tshul khrims bshad tsa na/ /mtho ris bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /thar pa bsgrub pa'i them skas can/ /sdug bsngal spong ba'i gnyen po can/ /tshul khrims la med thabs mi 'dug ste/ /tshe 'di la zhen pa'i tshul khrims de/ /chos brgyad bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /tshul khrims ngan la gshe ba can/

/tshul khrims ldan la phrag dog can/ /rang gi tshul khrims ngo phag can/ /ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i sa bon can/ /bcos ma'i tshul khrims bshol la zhog /thos bsam byed pa'i gang zag de/ /shes bya bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can/ /ma rig sel ba'i sgron me can/ /'gro ba 'dren pa'i lam rgyus can/ /chos kyi sku yi sa bon can/ /thos bsam la med thabs mi gda' ste/ tshe 'di la zhen pa'i thos bsam de/ nga rgyal bsgrub pa'i longs spyod can/ /thos bsam dman la brnyas pa can/ /thos bsam ldan la phrag dog can/ /'khor dang longs spyod 'tshol ba can/ /ngan 'gro bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /chos brgyad kyi thos bsam bshol la zhog /bsgom pa bgyid pa'i gang zag kun/ /nyon mongs spong ba'i gnyen po can/ /thar lam bsgrub pa'i rtsa ba can/ /gnas lugs rtogs pa'i longs spyod can/ /sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i sa bon can/ /bsgom pa la med thabs mi gda' ste/ tshe 'di la dmigs pa'i bsgom pa ste/ /dben par bsdad kyang 'du 'dzi can/ /long gtam smra ba'i kha ton can/ /thos bsam byed la skur ba can/ /bsgom pa gzhan la phrag dog can/ /rang gi sgom pa rnam g.yeng can/ /chos brgyad kyi bsam gtan bshol la zhog /mya ngan 'das pa bsgrub pa la/ khams gsum gyi zhen pa sbang yang 'tshal/ /khams gsum gyi zhen pa spong ba la/ /'khor ba'i nyes pa dran par 'tshal/ /dang po sdug bsngal gyi sdug bsngal de/ /ngan song gsum gyi sdug bsngal yin/ de legs par bsams na skyi sha 'bungs/ /thog tu babs na sran thabs med/ /spong ba'i dge ba mi bsgrub par/ /ngan song gi so nam byed byed pa/ /de gang na 'dug kyang the le le/ /'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal bsam tsa na/ /mtho ris ngan 'gror 'gro ba yod/ /brgya byin tha mal du skye ba yod/ /nyi zla mun par 'gro ba yod/ /bsgyur rgyal bran du skye ba yod/ /de lung la brten nas yid ches kyang / /phal pas rtogs par mi nus pas/

/rang snang mi yi 'gyur ba ltos/ /mi phyug po sprang por 'gro yin 'dug /kha drag po zhan por 'gro yin 'dug /mi mang po gcig tu 'gro yin 'dug /de la sogs pa bsam mi khyab/ /'du byed kyi sdug bsngal bsams tsa na/ /bya ba'i las la zin pa med/ /mi mang yang sdug ste nyung yang sdug /nor phyug kyang sdug ste ltogs kyang sdug /mi tshe thams cad grabs la zad/ /grabs byed pa'i 'phro la thams cad 'chi/ /shi yang grabs la zin pa med/ /tshe phyi ma'i grabs kyi mgo la 'jug /'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi phung po la/ /zhen par byed rnams the le le/ /zhen pa bral na mya ngan 'das/ /mya ngan 'das na bde ba thob/ /zhen pa bzhi bral nyams kyi dbyangs/ /bdag gcig pu thar bas phan rgyu med/ /khams gsum sems can pha ma yin/ /pha ma sdug bsngal gyi gseb tu bzhag /bdag bde bar 'dod pa the le le/ /khams gsum gyi sdug bsngal bdag la smin/ /bdag gi bsod nams sems can khyer/ /bsod nams 'di yi byin brlabs kyis/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgyas shog /bdag ji ltar 'dug kyang chos kyi ngang / /'dzin dang bcas pas grol ba med/ de yang zhib tu bshad tsam na/ /yod par 'dzin la thar pa med/ /med par 'dzin la mtho ris med/ /gnyis kar 'dzin pa mi shes pa/ /gnyis med kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /chos kun sems kyi spyod yul yin/ /phywa dang dbang phyug la sogs pa/ /'byung bzhi'i byed mkhan ma tshol bar/ /sems nyid kyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /snang ba sgyu ma'i rang bzhin dang / /rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yi/ /gnas lugs brjod par mi shes kyi/ /brjod bral gyi ngang la gang dgar zhog /zhen pa bzhi bral bshad pa yi/ /dge ba 'di yi bsod nams kyis/ /'gro ba bdun po ma lus pa/ /sangs rgyas sa la 'god par shog /zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams ngag rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis dpal sa skya'i dgon par sbyar ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT
